reason: B is the stronger proposal because CALPHAD supplies equilibrium solid–liquid free energies while atomistic simulations add volume and local-structure information, giving a more physically credible and testable route to the full property set than A’s NPT temperature ramps, which are prone to kinetic superheating and circular dependence on experimental calibration. B still needs sharper validation thresholds and realistic treatment of grain size, but its integrated approach more substantively extends the cited work.
